description: Literature search: full-text search across 61,000+ public-domain books (Project Gutenberg corpus). Pass 1 to 8 search words (all must appear in one passage). Returns ranked complete passages with book_id, title, author, section, passage location and Gutenberg source_url; ranks the first 400 matching candidates. Retrieval only: real cited passages, never LLM-generated text. No match answers 404 and is not charged. Costs $0.02 via x402 (requires WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY, USDC on Base).

query.description: 1 to 8 distinct search words (filler words ignored), max 200 characters, e.g. 'the nature of justice'

name: search_literature
